notes: The dative of וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם is recast as an English passive subject, so the preposition is unrepresented and the suffix takes they (rule 40).
In the multi-level chain כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל no article morpheme is present, so each written the goes to the nominal it stands before (rule 29).
